description:
About Silkiee
Silkiee is a premium beauty brand focused on delivering high-quality, results-driven products designed to enhance confidence and everyday routines. Our products are crafted to combine effectiveness, simplicity, and a clean aesthetic that customers love.

Why join our affiliate program?
• Earn competitive commissions on every sale
• High-converting products with strong customer appeal
• Reliable tracking and smooth user experience
• Fast and consistent payouts
• No limits, scale your earnings as much as you want

How you earn
You earn a commission for every successful purchase made through your unique referral link. With our optimized store and strong product demand, conversions are built into the system, making it easier for you to earn consistently.

How to promote Silkiee
You can promote Silkiee through:
• TikTok, Instagram, and other social platforms
• Content creation (videos, reels, UGC)
• Paid ads or organic traffic
• Blogs, reviews, and influencer pages

We provide a simple system that allows you to start quickly and scale your results.

Additional information
• Commission: 15% per order
• Cookie duration: 30–60 days
• Payouts: Every 14 days after order confirmation
• Dedicated support available for affiliates
payout_period: Payouts are processed every 14 days after order confirmation (to account for refunds/returns).
term_and_condition:
1. Overview

Welcome to the Silkiee Affiliate Program. By signing up, you agree to comply with the following terms and conditions. These terms are designed to ensure a fair and transparent relationship between Silkiee and its affiliates.

2. Eligibility

To join the Silkiee Affiliate Program, you must:

  • Be at least 18 years old
  • Provide accurate and complete information during registration
  • Have a valid platform (website, social media, or email list) to promote our products

Silkiee reserves the right to approve or reject any application at its discretion.

3. Commission Structure

  • Affiliates earn up to 15% commission on each successful sale made through their unique referral link
  • Commissions are calculated based on the net order value (excluding shipping, taxes, and refunds)
  • Silkiee reserves the right to modify commission rates at any time with notice

4. Tracking & Attribution

  • Each affiliate will receive a unique referral link
  • Sales are tracked using cookies and attribution technology
  • The default cookie duration is determined by the platform (UpPromote)
  • Silkiee is not responsible for tracking issues caused by ad blockers, browser settings, or incorrect link usage

5. Payment Terms

  • Commissions are approved after the order is successfully delivered and not refunded
  • Payments are issued on a regular basis (e.g., monthly)
  • Payments will be made via approved methods (e.g., PayPal or bank transfer)
  • Affiliates are responsible for providing accurate payment details

6. Prohibited Activities

Affiliates must NOT:

  • Engage in spam or unsolicited promotions
  • Use misleading, false, or exaggerated claims about Silkiee products
  • Bid on branded keywords (e.g., “Silkiee”) in paid advertising without permission
  • Use unauthorized discount codes or impersonate the brand
  • Engage in fraudulent activity or self-referrals

Violation may result in termination and forfeiture of commissions.

7. Brand Guidelines

Affiliates agree to:

  • Represent Silkiee in a professional and ethical manner
  • Use only approved branding materials (logos, images, messaging)
  • Maintain brand consistency and avoid damaging the brand’s reputation

8. Termination

Silkiee reserves the right to terminate any affiliate account at any time if:

  • Terms are violated
  • Fraudulent or unethical activity is detected
  • The affiliate damages the brand reputation

Any unpaid commissions may be withheld in such cases.

9. Limitation of Liability

Silkiee is not liable for:

  • Indirect or incidental damages
  • Loss of earnings due to system errors, tracking issues, or program changes

10. Modifications

Silkiee reserves the right to update or modify these terms at any time. Affiliates will be notified of significant changes.

11. Contact

For any questions regarding the affiliate program, please contact:

📧 support@silkiee.com
